{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id and keep the row with highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df = trial_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the final shape and first few rows
trial_df.shape, trial_df.head()"}
